prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, realistic handheld with subtle film grain, skin rendered as natural matte real skin with visible pores, fine lines and slight imperfections, the face stays non-reflective with no glossy oily highlights, no waxy plastic over-smoothed skin, no beauty-filter airbrushing and no CGI or 3D-render sheen. The over-the-shoulder framing shown in <Picture 1> stays fixed for the entire shot inside this same rain-streaked tavern window booth at night, under the same warm-white overhead and table-lamp light; the camera position and this single space never shift, cut away, or pan to any other background across the shot — no ceiling fan, no bare wall, no corridor and no restaurant hall ever enters the frame. In the soft-focus foreground, the East Asian man in his early thirties with light stubble (S2), his shoulder and blurred side profile kept in the position established by <Picture 1>, speaks softly toward her, his voice reaching her through the shallow depth of field. In sharp focus behind him, the East Asian young woman in her late twenties (S1) faces the camera, keeping her appearance and seating from <Picture 1>. The background stays clean, showing only the softly blurred night window seat; no rows of bottles, liquor shelf, wine rack, display case, wall poster, signage, storefront lettering, brand logo or brand text appear anywhere in the frame. The table holds only the plain unlabeled white ceramic bottle — cylindrical body, flat shoulder, short neck, red cap with a thin gold ring, entirely plain white with no text or logo — and the clear glass stemmed cups; no other bottles or vessels sit on the table or in the background. From the blurred foreground profile, speaking Mandarin at a normal, slightly quick pace with no dead air, he asks lightly: <d>[Chinese]第一次接吻，什么时候？</d> She smiles and answers, speaking Mandarin at a normal, slightly quick pace with no dead air, her tone light but with a trace of ache underneath: <d>[Chinese]2020 年 5 月 25 号，下着雨。</d> Right after she finishes, the two of them look at each other; in almost the same instant both of them break into a soft smile, then the smiles waver and their faces quietly tighten as they fall silent, both pressing their lips together and drawing a slow held breath, both of them wanting to stay and both fighting to keep the calm on their faces. She gives one slow blink and lowers her chin a fraction. Both faces stay completely plain, ordinary and photoreal throughout, with the normal matte skin already described and absolutely no added visual effects, no light effects and no lens flare anywhere on the face. No subtitles, no caption bar, no lyric strip and no on-screen text of any kind are burned into the frame.

overall_soundscape: Steady rain taps against the window while low indoor room tone and faint bar murmur continue underneath without pause. Two very light breaths of near-laughter pass between them as they look at each other, keeping the ambience continuous with no dead silence.
